definition.def: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability to do it.
examples: He appeared hardly capable of conducting a coherent conversation. [+ of]
The kitchen is capable of catering for several hundred people. [+ of]
I had no hesitation in calling the police because I realised he was capable of murder.

definition.def: Someone who is capable has the skill or qualities necessary to do a particular thing well, or is able to do most things well.
examples: Sam was a highly capable manager.
